title: StutterZero and StutterFormer: End-to-End Speech Conversion for Stuttering Transcription and Correction

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the performance disparity of standard automatic speech recognition (ASR) models (e.g., Whisper) on stuttered speech datasets (SEP-28K, LibriStutter, FluencyBank) using Word Error Rate (WER), Character Error Rate (CER), and BERTScore, and comparing these baselines against specialized end-to-end speech correction models to highlight and mitigate the exclusion of people who stutter.
